_comment: Frontend component registry. Grouped by app. Updated by sdd-architect (status: defined) and sdd-implementor-front (status: implemented | updated). Source of truth for all React components.

components.name: KudosWallPage
components.description: Route / — renders the kudos feed as a responsive grid of KudoCard, with EmptyState fallback and a Refresh / Load-more button pair driven by next_cursor.

components.name: NewKudoPage
components.description: Route /nuevo — hosts the KudoForm and handles the create flow, redirecting to / with the fresh kudo pushed to the top on success.

components.name: KudoCard
components.description: Single kudo tile: highlighted receiver, category chip, escaped message, giver caption, relative date with absolute-AR tooltip.

components.name: KudoForm
components.description: Controlled form with giver/receiver/category selects and message textarea. Enforces client-side validation (required fields, giver != receiver, 1..280 code points) and surfaces backend error envelope via banner.

components.name: CategoryChip
components.description: Colored chip displaying a category label. Color mapping is keyed by CategoryKey; used inside KudoCard.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Empty-feed placeholder with copy and CTA linking to /nuevo.

components.name: MembersCategoriesProvider
components.description: React Context that loads members and categories once and exposes them plus a helper to push a freshly-created kudo to the top of the feed.

components.name: useRelativeTime
components.description: Hook + helpers computing relative time (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat es-AR) and absolute time in America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. No external dependency.
